purpose: Rights-acquisition pilot for Explained editorial pages only
default_rule: Do not download, upload, publish, hotlink, or reuse an image until written permission or a documented licence covers the exact asset and intended use.

entries.title: This Is Fine
entries.requested_asset: Exact two-panel Gunshow comic crop commonly used as the meme
entries.recommended_action: Request a web-editorial licence, attribution wording, approved source file, territory, term and fee.
entries.fallback: Commission an original scene about calm denial during a crisis without copying Green's dog, panels or composition.

entries.title: Is This a Pigeon?
entries.rights_owner_or_route: Bandai Namco Filmworks / Sunrise licensing inquiry
entries.requested_asset: Exact still from The Brave Fighter of Sun Fighbird used by the meme
entries.recommended_action: Submit an audiovisual-usage inquiry identifying the episode, frame and editorial website use.
entries.fallback: Commission an original misidentification scene with unrelated characters and composition.

entries.title: One Does Not Simply
entries.rights_owner_or_route: Warner Bros. Discovery clip and still licensing
entries.requested_asset: Exact Boromir still from The Lord of the Rings: The Fellowship of the Ring
entries.recommended_action: Submit the official still-licensing form for the exact frame and editorial website use; confirm any separate talent approvals.
entries.fallback: Commission an original fantasy traveller making a warning gesture without LOTR characters, costume or setting.

entries.title: Success Kid
entries.recommended_action: Locate and verify a current representative or direct owner contact before making a licence request; do not rely on old Getty listings.
entries.fallback: Commission an original victory photograph with model release and a distinct pose and setting.

entries.title: Bad Luck Brian
entries.rights_owner_or_route: Photographer and/or portrait owner not yet verified
entries.requested_asset: Exact school portrait of Kyle Craven used by the meme
entries.recommended_action: Verify the photographer/copyright owner and Kyle Craven's current authorised licensing contact before requesting use.
entries.fallback: Commission an original awkward school-portrait character with releases.

entries.title: Philosoraptor
entries.rights_owner_or_route: Sam Smith, creator of the Lonely Dinosaur illustration
entries.recommended_action: Verify a current creator or representative contact and request a limited editorial web licence.
entries.fallback: Commission an original contemplative prehistoric character with a different species, silhouette and pose.

entries.title: Ancient Aliens
entries.rights_owner_or_route: A+E / HISTORY rights inquiry; separate personality clearance may apply
entries.requested_asset: Exact Giorgio A. Tsoukalos still used by the meme
entries.recommended_action: Ask A+E for the correct still-licensing desk and confirm whether talent approval is also required.
entries.fallback: Commission an original enthusiastic mystery presenter with a distinct appearance and gesture.

entries.title: Futurama Fry
entries.requested_asset: Exact Fry still from Futurama used by the meme
entries.recommended_action: Obtain the correct Disney/Fox still-licensing route and request permission for the exact frame.
entries.fallback: Commission an original uncertain character squinting, with unrelated design and setting.

entries.title: Surprised Pikachu
entries.requested_asset: Exact Pikachu anime still used by the meme
entries.recommended_action: Request the proper regional media/still-licensing contact and disclose the commercial, ad-supported editorial site context.
entries.fallback: Commission an original surprised creature that does not use Pokemon character features.

entries.title: Mocking SpongeBob
entries.requested_asset: Exact SpongeBob SquarePants still used by the meme
entries.recommended_action: Ask Paramount for the correct still-licensing desk and request permission for the exact frame and editorial context.
entries.fallback: Commission an original mocking character with unrelated anatomy, pose and setting.
